source: # S62A - Transform master legacy cases into MPA schema tables

# Parameters
LOCAL_DIR        = None              
FLATTEN_NEWLINES = True              
KEEP_DATELESS_TEXT_AS_NOTE = False  
NULL_COUNTS_TO_ZERO        = True    
STORAGE_ACCOUNT = None
STORAGE_KEY = None
PRE_SUFFIX = "/PRE"
MASTER_FILE  = "INPUT/MASTER/MASTER LIVE cases S62A - with extended data.xlsx"
MAPPING_FILE = "INPUT/MASTER/Spreadsheet to MPA schema mapping.xlsx"
LPAS_FILE    = "INPUT/MASTER/LPAs.xlsx"
OUTPUT_DIR   = "OUTPUT/TRANSFORM"


REF_DIGITS       = 7
REF_YEAR_COLUMNS = ["Notification received date", "Pre-app/Application received date", "Pre-app received date",
                    "Expected submission date", "Created on"]
MIGRATION_NOTE   = "Case reference created on migration"

DATA_SHEET  = "Final selected"
HEADER_ROWS = 3
REF_PATTERN = r"^S62A/(\d{4})/(\d{4}|\d{7})(RD)?$"

import re

ACCOUNTS = {
    "dev":  "pinssts62adevukseftlkl",
    "test": "pinssts62atestuksnkavj4",
    "prod": "pinssts62aproduksrz8i4g",
}

if LOCAL_DIR:
    ENV, ROOT = "local", LOCAL_DIR
else:
    from notebookutils import mssparkutils
    ws  = mssparkutils.env.getWorkspaceName().lower()
    m   = re.search(r"(?:^|[-_])(dev|test|prod)(?:[-_]|$)", ws)
    if not m:
        raise ValueError(f"Can't detect env from workspace name '{ws}'")
    ENV  = m.group(1)
    ROOT = f"abfss://s62a@{STORAGE_ACCOUNT or ACCOUNTS[ENV]}.dfs.core.windows.net/PIPELINE"

print(f"ENV={ENV} | ROOT={ROOT}")

# Imports
import os, re, csv, uuid
from datetime import datetime
import pandas as pd

LOC    = {"root": ROOT, "master": MASTER_FILE, "mapping": MAPPING_FILE, "lpas": LPAS_FILE, "output": OUTPUT_DIR, "key": STORAGE_KEY}
RUN_TS = datetime.utcnow().strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
TMP    = "/tmp/s62a_transform"
os.makedirs(TMP, exist_ok=True)

# Load files
def fetch(rel_path):
    if LOCAL_DIR:
        return os.path.join(LOCAL_DIR, os.path.basename(rel_path))
    local = os.path.join(TMP, os.path.basename(rel_path))
    mssparkutils.fs.cp(f"{LOC['root']}/{rel_path}", f"file:{local}")
    return local

if not LOCAL_DIR:
    from notebookutils import mssparkutils
    if LOC["key"]:
        account = re.search(r"@([^.]+)\.dfs", LOC["root"]).group(1)
        key = mssparkutils.credentials.getSecretWithLS(*LOC["key"]).strip()
        spark.conf.set(f"fs.azure.account.key.{account}.dfs.core.windows.net", key)

master_path  = fetch(LOC["master"])
mapping_path = fetch(LOC["mapping"])
lpas_path    = fetch(LOC["lpas"])

raw = pd.read_excel(master_path, sheet_name=DATA_SHEET, header=None, dtype=object)
# Row 3 used to hold the source of each column ("X (horizon)"); newer master files go straight to data.
# Without this check the first case (S62A/2022/5000001) is skipped as if it were a header row.
has_provenance = raw.iloc[2].astype(str).str.contains(r"\((?:horizon|spreadsheet)\)\s*$", case=False).any()
HEADER_ROWS = 3 if has_provenance else 2
print(f"Header rows: {HEADER_ROWS} ({'with' if has_provenance else 'no'} provenance row)")
fields = raw.iloc[1].astype(str).str.strip()
src = raw.iloc[HEADER_ROWS:].copy()
src.columns = fields
src = src.dropna(how="all").reset_index(drop=True)
src["Case reference"] = src["Case reference"].astype(str).str.strip()

mapping = pd.read_excel(mapping_path, sheet_name=0, dtype=str)
mapping.columns = ["source_column", "target_field", "target_table", "notes"][:len(mapping.columns)]
for c in ["source_column", "target_field", "target_table"]:
    mapping[c] = mapping[c].astype(str).str.strip().replace("nan", None)

print(f"Root: {ROOT} | cases: {len(src)} | columns: {len(fields)} | mapping rows: {len(mapping)}")

# Case references: pad Horizon refs to 7 digits, create refs for notifications without one
H_REF = re.compile(r"^S62A/(\d{4})/(\d{4}|\d{7})(RD)?$")
src["_original_ref"] = src["Case reference"]
src["_ref_class"] = src["_original_ref"].map(
    lambda r: "NONE" if not H_REF.match(r) else "PRE_APP" if len(H_REF.match(r).group(2)) == 7 else "APPLICATION")

def to_mpa_ref(r):
    y, num, rd = H_REF.match(r).groups()
    return f"S62A/{y}/{int(num):0{REF_DIGITS}d}{rd or ''}"

# 1. Horizon refs -> 7 digits, original kept as historical reference
if "Historical reference" not in src.columns:
    src["Historical reference"] = None
has_ref = src._ref_class != "NONE"
src.loc[has_ref, "Historical reference"] = src.loc[has_ref, "_original_ref"]
src.loc[has_ref, "Case reference"] = src.loc[has_ref, "_original_ref"].map(to_mpa_ref)
for r in src.loc[has_ref & src._original_ref.str.endswith("RD"), "_original_ref"]:
    log(to_mpa_ref(r), "scope", "Case reference", r, "Redetermination ref padded with RD suffix kept, confirm format", "INFO")

# 2. Notifications without a ref -> next number after the latest Horizon ref (4-digit series), year from received date
def ref_year(row):
    for c in REF_YEAR_COLUMNS:
        v = get(row, c)
        if not blank(v):
            d = pd.to_datetime(v, dayfirst=True, errors="coerce")
            if not pd.isna(d):
                return d.year, c, d
    return None, None, None

latest = max(int(H_REF.match(r).group(2)) for r in src.loc[has_ref, "_original_ref"]
             if len(H_REF.match(r).group(2)) == 4)
existing = set(src.loc[has_ref, "Case reference"])
generated_refs = []
missing = src[~has_ref].copy()
missing[["_year", "_year_from", "_year_date"]] = missing.apply(lambda r: pd.Series(ref_year(r)), axis=1)
next_num = latest + 1
for idx, row in missing.sort_values("_year_date", na_position="last").iterrows():
    original = row["_original_ref"]
    if pd.isna(row._year):
        log(original, "scope", "Case reference", original, "No case reference and no received date to create one, excluded")
        continue
    while f"S62A/{int(row._year)}/{next_num:0{REF_DIGITS}d}" in existing:
        next_num += 1
    new_ref = f"S62A/{int(row._year)}/{next_num:0{REF_DIGITS}d}"
    existing.add(new_ref)
    next_num += 1
    src.at[idx, "Case reference"] = new_ref
    src.at[idx, "_ref_class"] = "NOTIFICATION"
    extra_notes.append({"caseReference": new_ref, "noteType": "Case reference", "noteText": MIGRATION_NOTE})
    generated_refs.append({"originalValue": original, "generatedReference": new_ref,
                           "yearFrom": row._year_from, "yearDate": row._year_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")})
    log(new_ref, "scope", "Case reference", original,
        f"Reference created on migration: {new_ref} (year from {row._year_from})", "INFO")

cases = src[src["Case reference"].str.match(r"^S62A/\d{4}/\d{7}(RD)?$")].reset_index(drop=True)
print(f"In scope: {len(cases)} | Horizon refs padded: {has_ref.sum()} | refs created: {len(generated_refs)} "
      f"| excluded: {len(src) - len(cases)}")
print(f"Latest Horizon ref number: {latest:04d}")
for g in generated_refs:
    print(f"  {g['generatedReference']}  <-  {g['originalValue'][:60]}  ({g['yearFrom']} {g['yearDate']})")

d = pd.DataFrame(tables["S62aDates"])
pre = d["caseReference"].str.endswith(PRE_SUFFIX)
print(f"Pre-app cases: {pre.sum()} | with preApplicationReceivedDate: {d.loc[pre, 'preApplicationReceivedDate'].notna().sum()}")
print([c for c in d.columns if "eceived" in c.lower()])

# 1c. Case-level development totals (in the file, flagged "Add to schema" in the mapping)
TOTALS = {"TotalProposedResidentialUnits": "totalProposedResidentialUnits",
          "NetResidentialUnitChange": "netResidentialUnitChange",
          "NetAdditionalFloorspaceSqM": "netAdditionalFloorspaceSqM",
          "NonResExistingFloorspaceSqM": "nonResExistingFloorspaceSqM",
          "NonResFloorspaceLostSqM": "nonResFloorspaceLostSqM",
          "NonResFloorspaceProposedSqM": "nonResFloorspaceProposedSqM",
          "NonResNetFloorspaceSqM": "nonResNetFloorspaceSqM"}
totals_rows = []
for _, row in cases.iterrows():
    rec = {"caseReference": row["Case reference"], **{f: clean(get(row, c)) for c, f in TOTALS.items()}}
    if any(rec[f] is not None for f in TOTALS.values()):
        totals_rows.append(rec)
tables["S62aCaseTotals"] = totals_rows

# 4. Inspectors (1-3)
insp_rows = []
for _, row in cases.iterrows():
    for i in (1, 2, 3):
        user = get(row, f"Inspector {i}")
        if blank(user):
            continue
        insp_rows.append({"caseReference": row["Case reference"], "inspectorNumber": i, "user": clean(user),
                          "appointedDate": to_date(get(row, f"Date Inspector ({i}) allocated"), row["Case reference"],
                                                   "S62aCaseInspector", f"Date Inspector ({i}) allocated")})
tables["S62aCaseInspector"] = insp_rows
# 7. Notes table (note columns + text pulled out of date fields)
tables["S62aCaseNote"] = note_rows + [n for n in extra_notes if n["caseReference"]]
# 7a. Notes table (final, includes notes added above)
tables["S62aCaseNote"] = note_rows + [n for n in extra_notes if n["caseReference"]]

# 7b. GUID keys: deterministic uuid5 from a business key per table, never row position.

GUID_NAMESPACE = uuid.uuid5(uuid.NAMESPACE_URL, "pins-s62a-migration")

def make_guid(*parts):
    return str(uuid.uuid5(GUID_NAMESPACE, "|".join(str(p) for p in parts))).upper()

def norm(v):
    """Normalise a key part so spacing/case/1.0-vs-1 noise doesn't change the GUID."""
    if blank(v):
        return ""
    if isinstance(v, float) and v.is_integer():
        v = int(v)
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", str(v)).strip().casefold()

def person(r):
    """Who the contact is (email, else name, else org), not where they sat in the cell."""
    name = norm(f"{r.get('firstName') or ''} {r.get('lastName') or ''}")
    return norm(r.get("email")) or name or norm(r.get("orgName")) or f"seq{r.get('sequence')}"

def group(r):
    """Source group id where Horizon gives one, else position within the case."""
    return norm(r.get("groupId")) or f"seq{r.get('sequence')}"

# What makes a row unique WITHIN its case. Key on the type of thing, never on values that can be corrected
# (e.g. event type, not event date), so a fixed value updates the row instead of creating a new one.
BUSINESS_KEYS = {
    "S62aDates":                    lambda r: [],                                    # 1:1 with case
    "S62aFees":                     lambda r: [],                                    # 1:1 with case
    "S62aCaseTotals":               lambda r: [],                                    # 1:1 with case
    "S62aCaseLpa":                  lambda r: [norm(r["lpaRole"])],
    "Contact":                      lambda r: [norm(r["contactRole"]), person(r)],
    "Address":                      lambda r: [norm(r["addressType"])],
    "S62aCaseInspector":            lambda r: [r["inspectorNumber"]],                # fixed source slot, survives name fixes
    "S62aEvent":                    lambda r: [norm(r["eventType"])],
    "S62aVehicleParking":           lambda r: [group(r)],
    "S62aNonResidentialFloorspace": lambda r: [group(r)],
    "S62aResidentialHousing":       lambda r: [norm(r["housingType"]), group(r)],
    "S62aCaseWasteType":            lambda r: [norm(r.get("wasteType")) or f"seq{r.get('sequence')}"],
    "S62aCaseNote":                 lambda r: [norm(r["noteType"])],
}
undefined = {t for t, rows in tables.items() if rows} - set(BUSINESS_KEYS) - {"S62aCase"}
assert not undefined, f"No business key defined for: {sorted(undefined)}. Add one to BUSINESS_KEYS"

case_ids = {ref: make_guid("S62aCase", base_ref(ref)) for ref in cases["Case reference"]}
relationships, lineage = [], []
for t, rows in tables.items():
    if not rows:
        continue
    frame = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    if t == "S62aCase":
        keys = [(r,) for r in frame["caseReference"]]
        frame.insert(0, "id", frame["caseReference"].map(case_ids))
        relationships.append({"table": t, "primaryKey": "id", "foreignKey": None, "references": None, "relationship": "parent"})
    else:
        keys, seen = [], {}
        for r in frame.to_dict("records"):
            k = (r["caseReference"], *BUSINESS_KEYS[t](r))
            seen[k] = seen.get(k, 0) + 1
            if seen[k] > 1:   # genuine duplicate in source: keep both rows, flag it
                log(r["caseReference"], t, "id", "|".join(map(str, k)),
                    f"Business key not unique, occurrence {seen[k]} appended to key, check source")
                k = (*k, f"dup{seen[k]}")
            keys.append(k)
        frame.insert(0, "id", [make_guid(t, base_ref(k[0]), *k[1:]) for k in keys])
        frame.insert(1, "caseId", frame["caseReference"].map(case_ids))
        one_to_one = frame["caseReference"].is_unique and t in ("S62aDates", "S62aFees", "S62aCaseTotals")
        relationships.append({"table": t, "primaryKey": "id", "foreignKey": "caseId", "references": "S62aCase.id",
                              "relationship": "1 to 1" if one_to_one else "1 to many"})
        missing_fk = frame["caseId"].isna().sum()
        assert missing_fk == 0, f"{t}: {missing_fk} rows with no parent case"
    assert frame["id"].is_unique, f"{t}: duplicate GUIDs"
    lineage += [{"table": t, "id": i, "caseId": case_ids.get(k[0]), "caseReference": k[0], "businessKey": "|".join(map(str, k))}
                for i, k in zip(frame["id"], keys)]
    tables[t] = frame.to_dict("records")

relationships_df = pd.DataFrame(relationships)
lineage_df = pd.DataFrame(lineage)   # audit only: lets you trace any GUID back to its case and key
print(relationships_df.to_string(index=False))
print(f"\nGUIDs generated: {len(lineage_df)}")

# 8. Summary
summary = pd.DataFrame([{"table": t, "rows": len(r), "columns": len(pd.DataFrame(r).columns) if r else 0}
                        for t, r in tables.items()])
exceptions_df = pd.DataFrame(exceptions, columns=["severity", "caseReference", "table", "column", "value", "issue"])
exceptions_df.insert(1, "caseId", exceptions_df["caseReference"].map(case_ids))
print(summary.to_string(index=False))
print(f"\nExceptions: {len(exceptions_df)}")
print(exceptions_df.groupby(["severity", "issue"]).size().to_string())
